lines.en: label chinamidate1:
Come to think of it, I haven’t really spoken to Chinami over the phone yet.
lines.zh: 说起来，我还没真正跟 Chinami 通过电话呢。

lines.en: It would probably brighten her day to hear from someone, so maybe I’ll do that?
lines.zh: 要是有人打给她，她大概会开心一整天，所以要不我就打一个?

lines.en: Plus, it’s not like I have any qualms spending my free time chatting with a complete angel.
lines.zh: 再说，把空闲时间花在跟一个完完全全的小天使聊天上，我也没什么好顾虑的。

lines.en: The only issue is whether or not she’s even awake yet.
lines.zh: 唯一的问题是，她到底醒了没有。

lines.en: But, oh well. Won’t hurt to try I guess.
lines.zh: 不过算了。试试也没什么损失吧。

lines.en: I tap on Chinami’s name and wait to see if she answers.
lines.zh: 我点开 Chinami 的名字，等着看她会不会接。

lines.en: : Hello? Sensei?
lines.zh: : 喂？Sensei?

lines.en: : Oh, uhh. Hey.
lines.zh: : 哦，呃。嗨。

lines.en: : Why are you calling Chinami so early in the morning?
lines.zh: : 你为什么一大早就给 Chinami 打电话?

lines.en: : In fact, why are you calling Chinami at all?...
lines.zh: : 说起来，你到底为什么会给 Chinami 打电话?……

lines.en: : Oh, you know. I just thought she’d be happy to actually get a call from someone...
lines.zh: : 哦，你知道的。我只是觉得，能真的接到别人的电话，她会开心……

lines.en: : I can’t imagine she’s gotten to use her phone for its intended purpose yet so...Yeah.
lines.zh: : 我想她大概还没机会把手机用在它本来的用途上，所以……嗯。

lines.en: : It’s like 9:00 AM...It really couldn’t wait until later?
lines.zh: : 现在才早上九点左右……真就不能晚点再说吗?

lines.en: : I’m a busy guy, Chika.
lines.zh: : 我是个大忙人，Chika。

lines.en: : Well...I guess that’s true.
lines.zh: : 嗯……好像也对。

lines.en: : Chinami’s actually sleeping right now, but I’m really glad you called. I was actually just about to text you.
lines.zh: : Chinami 这会儿还在睡，不过我很高兴你打来了。我其实正准备给你发消息呢。

lines.en: : Really? For what?
lines.zh: : 真的？什么事?

lines.en: : Well, Yumi was supposed to come over to watch her this morning since I have work, but she just told me that she’s not feeling well and doesn’t want to get Chinami sick.
lines.zh: : 嗯，我今天要上班，本来 Yumi 该来照看她的，可她刚跟我说她不舒服，不想把病传染给 Chinami。

lines.en: : Soooo...I’m guessing you already know what I’m going to ask, right?
lines.zh: : 所、以……我猜你已经知道我要问什么了，对吧?

lines.en: : Right. You want me to dog-sit again.
lines.zh: : 对。你想让我再来当一次看狗的。

lines.en: : Hahahah~ Well she won’t be wearing her mask today, so it’s just normal Chinami-sitting.
lines.zh: : 哈哈哈~ 不过她今天不戴口罩，所以就是普通的看 Chinami。

lines.en: : I know you said you’re busy, but I’ll be eternally grateful if you could at least hang out here for a few hours so she doesn't wake up alone.
lines.zh: : 我知道你说你忙，不过如果你能至少在这儿待几个小时，让她醒来时不是一个人，我会感激你一辈子的。

lines.en: Well...It’s not like I had anything else going on this morning.
lines.zh: 嗯……反正我今天早上也没别的事。

lines.en: Chika’s place is pretty far, but I guess I can probably make it there in around half an hour.
lines.zh: Chika 家挺远的，不过我想大概半小时能到。

lines.en: : Yeah...I’ll head over now. You owe me, though.
lines.zh: : 好……我现在就过去。不过你欠我一次。

lines.en: : Heheh~ Of course I do. I won’t forget this. Promise.
lines.zh: : 呵呵~ 我当然欠。我不会忘的。保证。

lines.en: Chika hangs up the phone and, after getting dressed, I begin to head over...
lines.zh: Chika 挂了电话，我穿好衣服便动身过去……

lines.en: scene black
scene chinamifirstdate1
: Hey~ Thank you so so so so much. Really.
lines.zh: : 嘿~ 真的真的真的太谢谢你了。真的。

lines.en: : Don’t mention it. I’m free until the afternoon anyway.
lines.zh: : 别客气。反正我下午之前都有空。

lines.en: : That’s totally fine. Like I’ve said before, she’s fine alone. I just feel bad leaving her that way.
lines.zh: : 那完全没问题。就像我说过的，她一个人也没事。我只是不忍心就这么把她丢下。

lines.en: : Is she still asleep?
lines.zh: : 她还在睡吗?

lines.en: scene chinamifirstdate2
: Nah, she’s just sitting in front of the TV right now. I made breakfast before you got here, so you like, literally don’t need to do anything.
lines.zh: : 没，她现在就坐在电视前面。你到之前我就把早饭做好了，所以你基本上什么都不用做。

lines.en: : You can even just hang out in the kitchen if you want. I can’t imagine it’d be fun hanging out with someone so much younger than you anyway.
lines.zh: : 你要是愿意，就在厨房待着也行。反正跟一个比你小这么多的人待在一起，我想也不会多有趣。

lines.en: : I think you might be forgetting how much younger than me {i}you{/i} are, Chika.
lines.zh: : 我觉得你可能忘了，{i}你{/i}自己比我小多少，Chika。

lines.en: scene chinamifirstdate3
: Heheh~ I don’t count. You told me I’m mature for my age so I’m counting that as being on the same level as you.
lines.zh: : 呵呵~ 我不算。你说过我比同龄人成熟，所以我就当自己跟你平级了。

lines.en: : Do whatever you want. Not like that part matters to me anyway.
lines.zh: : 随你便。反正那一点对我来说无所谓。

lines.en: scene chinamifirstdate4
: Yeah, I think you made that pretty clear recently.
lines.zh: : 是啊，你最近把这一点表现得挺清楚的。

lines.en: : But yeah, just hang out here and do whatever for a few hours. You can leave whenever you want.
lines.zh: : 不过总之，在这儿待几个小时、随便干点什么就行。你什么时候想走都行。

lines.en: : When will you be back exactly?
lines.zh: : 你具体什么时候回来?

lines.en: : Not until later tonight, so don’t worry about staying the whole time.
lines.zh: : 要等到今晚很晚，所以别担心要不要待到最后。

lines.en: scene chinamifirstdate3
: You should know my schedule by now, Sensei. I’m at the mall every weekend.
lines.zh: : Sensei，你现在该清楚我的作息了吧。我每个周末都在商场。

lines.en: : Well hurry up and get going then. I’ll be fine here.
lines.zh: : 那就赶紧走吧。我在这儿没问题的。

lines.en: : Yeah, yeah. I’m going.
lines.zh: : 行行行。我走了。

lines.en: scene chinamifirstdate4
: Thanks again, though. Really.
lines.zh: : 不过还是要再谢你一次。真的。

lines.en: : You’ve been doing way too much for me lately. I have no idea how I’m going to repay you.
lines.zh: : 你最近为我做了太多事了。我都不知道该怎么报答你。

lines.en: : Figure that out later. Just go to work for now.
lines.zh: : 以后再想吧。现在先去上班。

lines.en: : Roger that.
lines.zh: : 收到。

lines.en: scene black
: Chinami! Don’t annoy Sensei while I’m gone!
lines.zh: : Chinami!我不在的时候不许缠着 Sensei!

lines.en: : Chinami will do her best!
lines.zh: : Chinami 会尽力的!

lines.en: : Have a nice day at work!
lines.zh: : 上班愉快!

lines.en: Chika exits the apartment, locking the door behind her and leaving me alone with her little sister.
lines.zh: Chika 出了公寓，随手锁上门，留下我和她妹妹独处。

lines.en: scene chinamifirstdate5
: Hello! Welcome to Chinami’s house!
lines.zh: : 你好!欢迎来到 Chinami 的家!

lines.en: : Did you wash your hands?
lines.zh: : 你洗手了吗?

lines.en: : Yeah, your sister made me wash them as soon as I came in.
lines.zh: : 洗了，你姐姐一进门就让我洗了。

lines.en: : Because she doesn’t want Chinami to get sick.
lines.zh: : 因为她不想让 Chinami 生病。

lines.en: : I don’t want Chinami to get sick either.
lines.zh: : 我也不想让 Chinami 生病。

lines.en: : That’s good.
lines.zh: : 那很好。

lines.en: : It sure is.
lines.zh: : 确实。

lines.en: : Now what?
lines.zh: : 然后呢?

lines.en: : What do you mean now what?
lines.zh: : 「然后呢」是什么意思?

lines.en: : Are you just going to sit there and stare at Chinami until her sister comes home?
lines.zh: : 你打算就这么坐着盯着 Chinami 看，一直看到她姐姐回来?

lines.en: : I...I haven’t really thought of that.
lines.zh: : 我……我还真没想过。

lines.en: Now that she mentions it, I have absolutely no idea what I’m even supposed to be doing right now.
lines.zh: 她这么一提，我才意识到自己根本不知道现在该干什么。

lines.en: I know Chika said it was fine to just hang out and do whatever, but it {i}does{/i} feel kind of weird being alone with a girl this small...even if she is a 5,000 year old wizard.
lines.zh: 我知道 Chika 说过随便待着、想干什么都行，但跟这么小的女孩单独待在一起，{i}确实{/i}有点怪……哪怕她是个五千岁的巫师。

lines.en: : You can stare at Chinami if you want. But she’s going to watch TV if that’s okay with you.
lines.zh: : 你想盯着 Chinami 看也行。不过她要看电视，如果你不介意的话。

lines.en: : Nothing’s even playing on the TV.
lines.zh: : 电视上什么都没在播啊。

lines.en: : Big sis says that the TV won’t come back on until tomorrow, so Chinami is pretending that her favorite show is on instead.
lines.zh: : 姐姐说电视要明天才会恢复，所以 Chinami 在假装她最喜欢的节目正在播。

lines.en: : And what exactly is Chinami’s favorite show?
lines.zh: : 那 Chinami 最喜欢的节目到底是什么?

lines.en: Knowing her, I’m assuming it’s some early morning cartoon or-
lines.zh: 以我对她的了解，估计是那种清晨的动画片之类的——

lines.en: scene chinamifirstdate6
: Game of Thrones.
lines.zh: : 《权力的游戏》。

lines.en: : I know I’m not the one who’s supposed to be raising you, but aren’t you a little too [young]for that?
lines.zh: : 我知道不该由我来管教你，可你看那个是不是有点太[young]了?

lines.en: : Chinami is a 5,000 year old-
lines.zh: : Chinami 可是五千岁的——

lines.en: : Wizard. I know. Does your sister know you watch it, though?
lines.zh: : 巫师。我知道。不过你姐姐知道你在看这个吗?

lines.en: scene chinamifirstdate7
: Mhm! We watch it together on her laptop whenever she brings it home.
lines.zh: : 嗯!她把笔记本带回家的时候，我们就一起看。

lines.en: I can’t say I know much about this show...but from what I understand, it can get pretty gruesome and...
lines.zh: 我对这部剧了解不多……不过据我所知，有些画面挺血腥的，而且……

lines.en: Well, let’s just say I was unaware that Chinami had been exposed to those kinds of things yet.
lines.zh: 好吧，只能说我之前不知道 Chinami 已经接触过那一类东西了。

lines.en: : So, you’re just sitting on a cushion pretending you’re watching Game of Thrones.
lines.zh: : 所以，你就坐在坐垫上，假装在《权力的游戏》。

lines.en: scene chinamifirstdate6
: Right. Chinami took a quiz on her phone that says she’s part of House Lannister.
lines.zh: : 没错。Chinami 在手机上做了个测试，说她属于 Lannister 家族。

lines.en: : I have no idea what that means. What does that house do?
lines.zh: : 我完全不知道那是什么意思。那个家族是干什么的?

lines.en: : They have a lot of money and like each other more than they’re supposed to I think.
lines.zh: : 他们很有钱，而且我觉得他们喜欢彼此喜欢得超出了应有的程度。

lines.en: : Having a lot of money is pretty much the exact opposite of you. You don’t have {i}any{/i} money, Chinami.
lines.zh: : 有钱这一点跟你差不多是完全相反。你{i}一点{/i}钱都没有，Chinami。

lines.en: : This is the sad truth.
lines.zh: : 这就是可悲的事实。

lines.en: scene chinamifirstdate7
: But that’s okay. Because one day, Chinami is going to be rich.
lines.zh: : 不过没关系。因为总有一天，Chinami 会变有钱的。

lines.en: : And then she's going to buy a big house for her and big sis.
lines.zh: : 然后她要给自己和姐姐买一栋大房子。

lines.en: scene chinamifirstdate5
: And you’ll get one too since you bought Chinami her first phone.
lines.zh: : 你也会有一栋，因为你给 Chinami 买了她的第一部手机。

lines.en: : Well thank you. But I already have a house.
lines.zh: : 哦谢谢。不过我已经有房子了。

lines.en: : That’s okay. You can have two houses. A Lannister always pays her debts.
lines.zh: : 没关系。你可以有两栋房子。Lannister 有债必还。

lines.en: : I’m assuming that’s a quote from the show, so I’m just going to say thanks.
lines.zh: : 我猜那是剧里的台词，那我就说声谢谢吧。

lines.en: : You’re welcome!
lines.zh: : 不客气!

lines.en: scene chinamifirstdate8
: Now, watch pretend-TV with me while we wait for big sis to finish working.
lines.zh: : 现在，陪 Chinami 一起看假装电视，等姐姐下班。

lines.en: : That’s going to be hours from now. We’re really going to stare at a blank TV the entire time?
lines.zh: : 那可是好几个小时之后的事。我们真要一直盯着一台空白的电视看?

lines.en: : It’s not blank! There are dragons and zombie things and a few really funny looking old people.
lines.zh: : 才不是空白!有龙、有僵尸什么的，还有几个长得特别好笑的老头老太太。

lines.en: : You’re not supposed to make fun of old people, Chinami.
lines.zh: : 不该嘲笑老人的，Chinami。

lines.en: : Shh! This is the best part!
lines.zh: : 嘘!最精彩的部分来了!

lines.en: Chinami ‘shushes’ me and I direct my attention (For reasons I don’t understand) to a blank TV screen.
lines.zh: Chinami「嘘」了我一声，而我把注意力（出于某种我自己也不明白的理由）投向了一片空白的电视屏幕。

lines.en: scene chinamifirstdate9
: This isn’t as fun as Chinami expected.
lines.zh: : 这没有 Chinami 想的那么好玩。

lines.en: : I can’t say I was really expecting any more from this.
lines.zh: : 我也不能说我本来指望它能更好玩。

lines.en: : Now what do we do?
lines.zh: : 那我们现在干什么?

lines.en: : I don’t know. It’s your house. You figure something out.
lines.zh: : 我不知道。这是你家。你自己想。

lines.en: scene chinamifirstdate10
: Wanna watch Chinami kill pigs? She’s really good at it.
lines.zh: : 想看 Chinami 杀猪吗？她可擅长了。

lines.en: : I’m a little worried about your enthusiasm for killing animals. You know there are other games you can play on your phone, right?
lines.zh: : 你对杀动物这么来劲，我有点担心。你知道你手机里还能玩别的游戏吧?

lines.en: scene chinamifirstdate11
: Other games?
lines.zh: : 别的游戏?

lines.en: : Yeah. Like, that one where you crush candy. Or that one with the farm.
lines.zh: : 是啊。比如那个碾糖果的。或者那个农场的。

lines.en: : Can Chinami destroy the animals on the farm?
lines.zh: : Chinami 能弄死农场里的动物吗?

lines.en: : That’s...not really the point of the game, but probably? I don’t really know.
lines.zh: : 那……不是游戏的重点，不过大概可以？我也不是很清楚。

lines.en: : You don’t seem to know as much as big sis when it comes to phones, Mr. Sensei.
lines.zh: : 说到手机，你好像没有姐姐懂得多呢，Sensei 先生。

lines.en: : Just Sensei is fine, Chinami.
lines.zh: : 就叫 Sensei 就好，Chinami。

lines.en: : Okay, Just Sensei.
lines.zh: : 好的，就叫 Sensei 先生。

lines.en: : You did that on purpose, didn’t you?
lines.zh: : 你是故意的吧?

lines.en: : Chinami has no idea what you’re talking about. She’s just a little girl who is also an ancient wizard.
lines.zh: : Chinami 完全不知道你在说什么。她只是个小女孩，同时是个远古巫师。

lines.en: : I’m beginning to think you might be smarter than you let on, Chinami...
lines.zh: : 我开始觉得，你可能比表现出来的聪明，Chinami……

lines.en: : Chinami is very confused right now.
lines.zh: : Chinami 现在很困惑。

lines.en: : {i}Sure she is...{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}她当然困惑了……{/i}

lines.en: : Are you and big sis getting married yet?
lines.zh: : 你和姐姐结婚了吗?

lines.en: This again? How does this keep coming up?
lines.zh: 又来了？这事怎么老被提起?

lines.en: : How many times do the two of us need to tell you that things aren’t like that between us?
lines.zh: : 我们俩要说多少遍，我们之间不是那种关系?

lines.en: : A few more, probably. Chinami’s memory isn’t very good.
lines.zh: : 大概还得再说几遍。Chinami 记性不太好。

lines.en: : But she thinks you should get married anyway.
lines.zh: : 不过她觉得你们还是该结婚。

lines.en: scene chinamifirstdate12
: If Sensei and big sis get married, Chinami will be alone less.
lines.zh: : 如果 Sensei 和姐姐结婚，Chinami 一个人的时间就少了。

lines.en: : Is that why you want us to get married? So I’ll come around more?
lines.zh: : 你想让我们结婚，就是为了这个？好让我多来几趟?

lines.en: : Maybe.
lines.zh: : 也许吧。

lines.en: : You know I can just, come around more {i}without{/i} marrying her, right?
lines.zh: : 你知道我{i}不{/i}跟她结婚也可以多来几趟吧?

lines.en: : Chinami also wants a little sister.
lines.zh: : Chinami 还想要个妹妹。

lines.en: : ...Okay, that one is a little less doable.
lines.zh: : ……好吧，这一条就比较难办了。

lines.en: scene chinamifirstdate11
: Big sis said she’d have a baby if it’s with you, Sensei.
lines.zh: : 姐姐说过，如果是和你，她愿意生宝宝，Sensei。

lines.en: : I do not believe a word of that, Chinami. You’re deceiving me.
lines.zh: : 我一个字都不信，Chinami。你在骗我。

lines.en: : Chinami doesn’t know what that word means, but she’s telling the truth.
lines.zh: : Chinami 不知道那个词是什么意思，可她说的是实话。

lines.en: : Why would your sister even say that? Something’s not adding up here.
lines.zh: : 你姐姐为什么会说那种话？这里头有点对不上。

lines.en: : Chinami doesn’t even know where babies come from because you wouldn’t tell her. She has no reason to lie.
lines.zh: : Chinami 连宝宝是从哪儿来的都不知道，因为你又不肯告诉她。她没有撒谎的理由。

lines.en: : Good. I have no intention of telling you something like that.
lines.zh: : 很好。我也不打算告诉你那种事。

lines.en: : Okay. I’ll ask big sis.
lines.zh: : 好吧。那我去问姐姐。

lines.en: : No. Definitely don’t do that either. She’ll think it was me who said something.
lines.zh: : 不行。这个也绝对不行。她会以为是我说的。

lines.en: : Then Chinami will ask big sis Yumi. She looks mature so she probably knows.
lines.zh: : 那 Chinami 去问 Yumi 姐姐。她看起来很成熟，应该知道。

lines.en: : Actually, yes. Do that. I’m sure Yumi will be willing to tell you all about it. She won’t get flustered even one bit.
lines.zh: : 说真的，去吧，就这么办。我相信 Yumi 一定很乐意跟你好好讲讲。她一点都不会慌的。

lines.en: scene chinamifirstdate13
: Hooray! Chinami will learn a new thing soon! And no thanks to her future daddy!
lines.zh: : 万岁!Chinami 很快就能学到新东西了!一点都不靠她未来的爸爸!

lines.en: : Marrying your sister wouldn’t even make me your daddy. I’d have to marry your mom.
lines.zh: : 就算跟你姐姐结婚，我也成不了你爸爸。我得跟你妈妈结婚才行。

lines.en: scene chinamifirstdate14
: Hi, Mom. Can you do me a favor?
lines.zh: : 你好，妈妈。你能帮 Chinami 一个忙吗?

lines.en: Things suddenly become incredibly morbid and don’t mesh well with the background music. Such is life.
lines.zh: 气氛突然变得极其病态，和背景音乐格格不入。生活就是这样。

lines.en: : Can you marry Sensei? He is a nice man and he bought Chinami a phone.
lines.zh: : 你能嫁给 Sensei 吗？他是个好人，还给 Chinami 买了手机。

lines.en: : Chinami wants to take care of a sister the way big sis takes care of Chinami.
lines.zh: : Chinami 想照顾一个妹妹，就像姐姐照顾 Chinami 那样。

lines.en: : Also Sensei has glasses and big sis says you always liked boys with glasses.
lines.zh: : 还有 Sensei 戴眼镜，姐姐说你一直喜欢戴眼镜的男生。

lines.en: : Chinami...
lines.zh: : Chinami……

lines.en: : Shh...I’m talking to my mom. Watch pretend-TV, Sensei.
lines.zh: : 嘘……我在跟妈妈说话。看假装电视吧，Sensei。

lines.en: : ...Fine.
I pretend to watch pretend-TV and fall into pretend-inception.
lines.zh: 我假装看着假装电视，然后陷入了假装的多层梦境。

lines.en: How did a trip to hang out with my student’s little sister turn into something so complicated?
lines.zh: 本来只是去陪学生的妹妹玩一趟，怎么就变得这么复杂了?

lines.en: scene chinamifirstdate15
: {i}Also, he has lots of money. He even paid for Yumi’s phone. I think he works for the government.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}还有，他很有钱。他连 Yumi 的手机都是他买的。我觉得他是给政府工作的。{/i}

lines.en: : Chinami, what in the world are you whispering about over there? I think I just heard something about the government.
lines.zh: : Chinami，你在那边嘀咕什么呢？我好像听见了「政府」什么的。

lines.en: : No words, Sensei. Chinami needs silence to reach her mom through the picture.
lines.zh: : 别说话，Sensei。Chinami 需要安静，才能通过照片联系到妈妈。

lines.en: : ...Whatever Chinami needs.
lines.zh: : ……随 Chinami 的便。

lines.en: scene black
Chinami spends the next twenty minutes whispering to the picture of her mother while I sit next to her, pretending to not hear what she’s saying.
lines.zh: 接下来的二十分钟里，Chinami 一直在对着她妈妈的照片低声说话，而我坐在她旁边，假装没听见她在说什么。

lines.en: It’s an incredibly uncomfortable morning, especially when you realize that she’s basically trying to get her mom to agree to have sex with me.
lines.zh: 这是个极其难熬的上午，尤其是当你意识到，她基本上是在说服她妈妈同意跟我上床。

lines.en: Now, let’s get one thing straight.
lines.zh: 现在，先把一件事说清楚。

lines.en: I am a man with very low morals.
lines.zh: 我是个道德水平很低的人。

lines.en: But even I don’t think I’d stoop as low as having sex with the Chosokabes' mother.
lines.zh: 但就算是我，也不觉得自己会下作到跟长宗我部姐妹的母亲上床。

lines.en: If she were alive, that would be another story but-
lines.zh: 如果她还活着，那就是另一回事了，不过——

lines.en: Wait a minute. What the fuck am I even saying right now?
lines.zh: 等等。我他妈现在到底在说什么?

lines.en: {i}The next few hours pass by without becoming any more comfortable.{/i}
lines.zh: {i}接下来的几个小时过去了，气氛丝毫没有变自在。{/i}

lines.en: {i}But at least Chinami didn’t spend the day alone.{/i}
lines.zh: {i}但至少 Chinami 这一天不是一个人过的。{/i}

lines.zh: {i}Chinami 的好感度提升到了 [chinami_love]!{/i}
